description: Free read-only morning brief in one call: weather, S&P 500 / Dow / NASDAQ, BTC/ETH/SOL with 24h change, top-5 news. Use when the user asks for a daily brief, morning digest, market+weather snapshot, or "what's happening today. Do NOT use for single-fact lookups or for tickers/coins/countries outside the fixed set — use search_endpoints → call_endpoint instead; Rate limit: 20 calls / 5 min per agent (key = x-agent-id, else ip:user-agent); exceeding → 429 + Retry-After as errors[].retryAfter.

newsreg.description: 2-letter ISO country code for news. If omitted, defaults to worldwide headlines. Non-2-letter → -32602 before any upstream call.

weatherreg.description: City for weather. If omitted, the server tries IP-based geolocation of the caller. If geolocation fails, the weather block is skipped and logged in errors[].

name: day_summary

blocks.description: Successfully fetched blocks. Any subset of weather / indices / crypto / news. Blocks that failed are absent and listed in `errors`.

failed.description: Only present when some symbols failed but at least one succeeded.

properties.description: Seconds to wait before retrying this symbol.

indices.description: One entry per successfully fetched index. Upstream set is fixed: ^GSPC, ^DJI, ^IXIC.

region.description: Region code that was applied ("world" if none).

time.description: ISO-like local time from Open-Meteo, not RFC3339.

errors.description: Blocks that failed. Empty array when everything succeeded.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying this block.
